name: Giant Mosquitoes
description: Dozens of fist-sized mosquitoes, flying together for protection.

abilities.name: Horde (1d4+1)
abilities.description: When the Mosquitoes have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: While flying, the Mosquitoes have a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

abilities.name: Bloodsucker
abilities.description: When the Mosquitoes’ attack causes a target to mark HP, you can mark a Stress to force the target to mark an additional HP.
